text:
mira: Quick sync — product wants a fresh battlecard row + two bench hooks for next launch (opponents: cloud-managed endpoints, LLM APIs, infra stacks). Keep SDR language tiny and defensible.

ash: Request: give SDRs 3 opens (<=12 words) + 3 one-liner comebacks to 'we use vendor X'.

ton y: Draft opens: 1) "Seeing surprise inference bills? 10min to fix." 2) "Want SLA-backed p99s without rip-and-replace?" 3) "Curious how serving reduces token spend?" Short and punchy.

kevin: For comebacks: A) "Sizing up still leaves tail spikes; we optimize serving to lower cost and tame tails." B) "We layer onto your models — no migration required." C) "Reserved vs burst economics explained in 2 bullets."

sdr-bot: upload: playtest slot requested Friday 09:30 PT — 4 reps.

mira: Bench hooks need to be defendable with method notes. Two hooks: cost-first and latency-first. Keep each to one sentence + one-line methodology.

bench-bot: upload: https://drive.redwood/bench/1791239999/traces_5k.csv (auto)

ash: Cost hook (one-liner): "~30% lower token unit cost on batch generators via continuous batching + quantization." Method: 8k mixed traces, injected peak windows, compare naive endpoint vs continuous batching.

ton y: Latency hook (one-liner): "p99 reduced from ~1.2s to ~360ms using smart routing + prefix KV cache." Method: 5k real chat traces, measured p95/p99 across routing policies; CI included.

kevin: Add a single battlecard row for operational lift: "Cloud: low friction to start, ops grow with scale; Redwood: small setup, predictable ops and cost governance." Keep it one line.

mira: Webinar hook: open with a 2-sentence customer vignette (retail spike), show 2 visuals (cost over time, p99 waterfall), demo a tail tracer live, CTA = "Book a 15-min tail review for your workload."

ash: SDR playbook ask: paste the 3 opens + 3 comebacks into the SDR folder and run a 5-rep playtest Thursday AM. Capture top-performing open and top failed objection.

bench-bot: reminder: raw CSV uploaded, analytics conversion recommended (slide with cost delta + p99 before/after).

kevin: I'll build the slide if analytics exports the two panels. Mira — can you lock the numeric claim? We should pick a defensible stat (e.g., "~30% token cost reduction on batched generators").

mira: Locking claim to "~30% token cost reduction on batch generators (8k-sample, 95% CI)". Post any counter-evidence in this thread; we'll craft neutral counters focused on serving-first differentiation.

ash: One more — subject line A/B for invite: A) "Stop surprise inference bills — 15min demo" B) "See a live p99 tail-trace — 15min". We'll run a short test.

mira: Timeline: SDR script + objections by Wed EOD, bench narratives by Wed noon, slides Thu AM, playtest Thu/Fr. Thanks team.

kevin: Adding playtest schedule to calendar.

mira: Wrap — post any hard competitor lines here and we'll fine-tune language. :sparkles:
